text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one error in a slice bound in cli/commands/deploy.py was causing the deploy command to hang on exit.","The deploy command hang was fixed by correcting the slice bound and adding a property test, submitted in PR #2398 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1.","The deploy command hang error rate decreased from 3.7 percent to under 0.09 percent after the fix.","The deploy command hang could be reproduced by deploying the sample project and waiting for the process to complete.","Test coverage for the deploy command hang fix is in tests/cli/test_deploy.py.","The deploy command hang issue only manifested after the client had already retried once."]}
